items.title: Efficient Ink Supply System
items.desc: Ensures consistent ink flow to printheads at all times, preventing ink starvation and maintaining uninterrupted production across long print runs.

items.title: Head Crash Protective System
items.desc: Sensor-based protection system safeguards printheads from fabric obstructions during carriage movement, reducing damage risk and extending printhead lifespan.

items.title: Wrinkle Controller System
items.desc: High-precision sensor controls detect and correct fabric surface irregularities in real time, ensuring smooth, uniform media conveying for flawless output.

items.title: 5-Stage Belt Squeeze System
items.desc: Advanced water-resistant squeeze system prevents lint and dust blockage — engineered specifically for high-lint textile production environments, reducing cleaning downtime significantly.

items.title: Linear Motor Precision System
items.desc: Linear motor drives carriage movement with smooth acceleration and positioning accuracy, maintaining ±0.1mm registration across the full 1800mm print width even at production speeds.

items.title: Automatic Capping & Wiping System
items.desc: Keeps printheads clean between runs, preventing ink from drying on nozzles and reducing ink wastage — extending printhead life and ensuring consistent first-drop quality.

items.title: Customizable Drying System
items.desc: Integrated belt + fins heater with adjustable temperature control, optimised for different fabric types — from lightweight silk to heavy cotton and upholstery fabrics.

items.title: Higher Mechanical Precision
items.desc: Tighter mechanical tolerances improve overall print accuracy and registration for sharper, repeatable output.

items.title: Integrated Feeding System
items.desc: Built-in feeding system supports roll diameters of up to 400 mm for smooth, continuous media handling.

items.title: Precise X-Motion Guideway System
items.desc: Maintains accurate carriage positioning across the full print width for consistent registration.

items.title: One-Touch Maintenance
items.desc: Automated daily maintenance routines minimise operator intervention and keep the machine production-ready with minimal downtime.

brochure.title: Product Brochure
brochure.desc: Complete technical specifications, engineering details, installation requirements, and component overview for the FabPro 1i.

paragraphs: FabPro 1i is a digital fabric printing machine built for textile manufacturers who need reliable, high-quality output across a wide range of fabrics. With 8 Ricoh Gen 6 industrial printheads, an 8-colour ink setup and automated maintenance, it prints vibrant designs directly onto fabric at up to 110 linear metres an hour.

sections.heading: Fabric Compatibility and Post-Printing Process
sections.intro: FabPro 1i prints on fabrics from 30 to 450 gsm, from lightweight silk to heavier furnishing fabrics. Each fabric needs the right ink and the right finishing process for the colour to fix permanently.
rows: Reactive or disperse, based on the main fibre
sections.note: Fabric should be pretreated before printing for the best colour yield and sharpness.

sections.heading: Production Output and Print Quality on a Digital Fabric Printing Machine
sections.intro: FabPro 1i prints at up to 80 lm/hr in standard mode and up to 110 lm/hr at maximum speed.
sections.note: Speed and quality depend on the print mode. Bi-directional printing is faster and suits most production. Single-direction printing is slower but gives the cleanest results on fine detail and gradients. Fabric type matters too: dense, absorbent fabrics and dark designs often need slower modes for even coverage. With 8 colours (CMYK plus Orange, Red, Blue and Green) and up to 600 × 900 dpi resolution, FabPro 1i reproduces bright, saturated shades across all supported fabrics.

sections.heading: Production Setup and Installation
paragraphs: FabPro 1i takes rolls up to 400 mm in diameter and 200 kg, with a maximum media width of 1,850 mm. A 15-litre ink tank supports long runs without frequent refills, and the machine runs on neoStampa RIP software.

paragraphs.title: Before installation, plan for:
list: Floor space for the machine, roll loading, operator access and fabric storage
Stable power with voltage stabilisation and backup
Auxiliary equipment: pretreatment before printing, plus a steamer and washer for reactive and acid inks, or heat fixation for disperse
A controlled print room with stable temperature and humidity and minimal dust
paragraphs.footnote: Our team shares exact dimensions and power requirements during site planning.

sections.heading: Printhead Maintenance and Downtime Prevention
paragraphs: FabPro 1i is built to reduce the downtime that slows most textile printers:

list: Sensor-based head crash protection detects fabric obstructions and protects the Ricoh Gen 6 heads from damage
Real-time wrinkle control keeps fabric flat and feeding smoothly, even on delicate fabrics
Automated capping and wiping keeps nozzles moist and clean between jobs
One-touch maintenance makes routine cleaning quick and simple
An efficient ink supply keeps ink flow steady on long runs

paragraphs: For daily operation, run a nozzle check at the start of each shift, use the one-touch cleaning when nozzles drop out, and keep the print belt clean.

items.q: What is a digital fabric printing machine?
items.a: A digital fabric printing machine prints designs directly onto fabric from a digital file, without screens. FabPro 1i uses 8 Ricoh Gen 6 industrial printheads to print on cotton, linen, silk, nylon, polyester and blends.

items.q: What is the price of FabPro 1i?
items.a: The price depends on configuration and the auxiliary equipment you need. Contact our team for a quote based on your fabric range and production volume.

items.q: What does it cost to run?
items.a: Running cost includes ink, fabric pretreatment, post-processing (steaming, washing or heat fixation), power and labour. Ink use varies with design coverage and print mode, so dark, full-coverage designs cost more per metre than light ones.

items.q: What other equipment do I need?
items.a: You’ll need pretreatment equipment, plus a steamer and washer for reactive and acid inks, or a heat fixation unit for disperse ink.
Automated capping, wiping and one-touch maintenance handle most routine care. Operators should run a nozzle check every shift and keep the print belt clean.

items.q: Does Orange O Tec provide installation and training?
items.a: Yes. Our team handles installation and operator training, and Orange O Tec’s 85+ service engineers provide after-sales support across India.
